save.text: Giveaway: at 4,200 subs LL1973 won a signed D&D 5e PHB + cast photo; more every +50 subs (next 4,250).
Schedule: No Critical Role next week for SDCC; panel Thu at PetCo Park (no badge), filmed and streamed next day.
Further break: Following week Matt and Marisha in New Zealand (Armageddon); no main-story for two weeks; others will stream other games/chat.
Tech: Intro video malfunction; stream is live otherwise. Orion was Periscoping, thought they weren’t live; Matt/crew confirm they were. Plan: skip intro and start game.
Guest/arrivals: Sam arrived mid-opening; Ashley wanted to show a cool guest on break, not before.

Story recap (Matt): Vox Machina carrying indestructible Horn of Orcus to Vasselheim’s Platinum Sanctuary via skyship; attacked by wyvern/griffin bandits, took a captive; journey ~6–7 days; currently still in the air.
Captive halfling mage from bandits: Captain Damon refused hiring; she’s locked in ship’s anti-magic brig awaiting fate.
Travel: Several days pass uneventfully over the Ozmit Sea; party fully rested with spells recovered; Percy reads.
Grog’s beard: magical growth to ~1–1.5 inches, translucent; Keyleth braids with beads/flowers; goliaths don’t grow facial hair—potential long-term detriment per Matt.
Grog’s beard now a 3–4 inch dark brown braided goatee; previously translucent; Grog proud.
Mid–day of 6th travel day: weather turns colder and overcast; Keyleth Nature 20 confirms natural cold northern weather.
Item trade: Scanlan agrees to trade his circlet/crown to Tiberius for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone after Tiberius’s argument.
Item trade confirmed: Scanlan takes Tiberius’s Ioun Stone (stores up to three spells, no slots to cast); he’s convinced and equips it orbiting his head.
Weather: Temp drops; specks of snow ahead as they near Vasselheim mid–day 6th day continues.
Keyleth reveals Fire Ashari reside near Vasselheim in Pyrah; proposes visiting after Horn delivery as part of her Aramente to meet headmasters.
Keyleth shares her mother left when Keyleth was ~5–6; unknown tribe/status. Party plans to visit Pyrah near Vasselheim and may ask if she’s been seen.
Approach to Vasselheim: Land sighted on Othanzia; Vesper Timberland noted; city is massive, heavily fortified with layered ancient-to-modern walls and dragon-headed ballistae.
Scanlan took Tiberius’s Ioun Stone (stores up to three spells, no slots to cast) and equipped it orbiting his head—trade confirmed.
Arrival Vasselheim: Skyship docks on improvised mill-top platform; city shows rebuilt battle scars; cold climate—party equips winter cloaks/robes.
Rest status: Short rest occurred before arrival per Matt’s confirmation to Tiberius.
Scanlan’s Ioun Stone: he stored a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt; stone is white with greenish-blue glow when charged; still costs slot initially, then held post-rest.
Kima: last with her Order eight years ago; appears nervous about reunion; confirms they’re about to meet them.
Arrival reception: Met Scalebearer Yonn (bald, spectacles) leading gray-tabarded militia; he insists on title; escorting party with artifact.
Platinum Sanctuary is ~25-minute walk from docks; plan is to escort Horn there promptly, few in city know (only Yonn, Vox Machina, Highbearer Vord).
Vasselheim culture/security: entry by foot only; guards display holy symbols (Arathis, Avandra, Melora, some Bahamut); none for Sarenrae.
Escort formation change: Keyleth aerial as eagle; Vex on rooftops (rolled 1, noticed); Grog/Ashley on path with box; Tiberius rear; Vax blending with crowd (stealth 23).
Scalebearer Yonn uneasy with chromatic dragonborn; Tiberius used Alter Self to appear metallic; Yonn warned not to do magic publicly.
Vasselheim treats public arcane as profane; strictly controlled; harsh, oldest holy city with ancient temples; residents view hardship as devotion.
Procession carries ornate platinum/silver box with blue sapphires (Horn container); ~2x2 ft; noticeable but not causing a scene; guards still flanking.

Entered Bahamut’s Platinum Sanctuary: long staircase ascent; ancient fortress with ivory/silver spires; Draconic words like “honor, justice”; Bahamut shield-dragon symbol on doors opening as Scalebearers approach.
Vasselheim militia: Bastions are volunteer civilian guards; about a quarter of populace; patchwork armor; envoys in blue/silver are from Bahamut’s temple, not Bastions.
Inside Bahamut’s Platinum Sanctuary; party enters as doors close; Keyleth stayed outside to scout moving trees; Vax slipped in last moment before doors shut.
Outside city: Keyleth (eagle) sees large multi-serpentine creature under dense snowy canopy; ballista fired from walls; screech heard; creature retreats—seems a common occurrence near Vasselheim.
Inside Bahamut’s Platinum Sanctuary; Keyleth arrested on entry but Kima vouched for her—Scalebearers uncuffed and withdrew embarrassed; party continues deeper.
Scalebearer Yonn leading through plain ancient stone fortress-temple; strong divine energy felt (Pike rates it “six” holy); Kima warns to avoid fraternizing here.
Outside threat: multi-serpentine creature near Vasselheim is common per defenses; Keyleth earlier scouted it; now Keyleth rejoined party inside after brief arrest.
Yonn opens second sanctum doors with holy symbol; central domed worship chamber revealed.
In Platinum Sanctuary: Highbearer Vord (elder elf, Bahamut regalia) greets; Kima kneels as his disciple; Vord asks for artifact to be sealed.
Vord confirms the container holds a Horn of Orcus via divine sensing; orders immediate sealing; Scalebearers told not to open it.

Plan: Seal Horn in Hall of the Exalt beneath temple; lower chambers infested by subterranean spider creatures; Yonn fled after triggering some vault defenses; party asked to clear beasts and escort Scalebearers carrying the reliquary.
Vord: Temple and vault are heavily warded under Bahamut’s gaze; some defenses pre-set; Scalebearers will accompany and carry the box; keep them safe.

Star of Exaltation lore: Bahamut’s tear-formed crystal created in the Dawn War; used 300 years ago to defend Vasselheim and was destroyed/expended; its watched chamber now repurposed to seal the Horn.
Scan: Vex used Primeval Awareness; no dragons within six miles of the city.
Temple reward: Highbearer offered 3,000 gp total; agreed to be given once the Horn is delivered and sealed; Scanlan secured deal with a Deception roll of 30.
Proceeding now: Immediate descent to seal the Horn; Kima accompanies to the vault; party heading into lower, musty storage/basement levels.
Vault entry: Kima used holy symbol to dispel illusory wood, revealing stone doorway and stair; she admits she’s never been in the vault.
First chamber: 50x50 ft, low sconces, thick white mist refills; two dragon-carved pillars floor-to-ceiling with rotatable bases; dragon mouths emit the mist.
Checks: Vax found no traps on stairs (Perception 26); later spotted pillar bases have gaps (pivot).

Mist chamber trap: Contact with side mist triggers all dragon-mouth vents to spin and blast fire; initial run split party; Dex saves: Vax 0 dmg (Uncanny Dodge on success), Tiberius 12, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike 24.
Mist cleared by Keyleth’s Gust/Wind twice; second casting maintained a safe center path; remaining party and Scalebearers crossed during its 1-minute duration.
Party status: Group was briefly split by trap; reunited after Keyleth’s second wind cleared path; Scalebearers are with them.
Mist room resets: After Keyleth’s wind ended, the mist refilled and re-obscured the chamber behind them as they proceeded.
New room: Circular chamber with floor of many circular plates; stepping a circle triggers room to rotate and plates piston upward into ceiling as crushing pillars.
Vax test: Hasted leap onto first circle triggered trap; succeeded Dex save (nat 20) to avoid first pillar; took 40 crushing damage from later pillar while crossing; acrobatics checks 18 then 23.
Vax crosses plate room to staircase; Perception 25 spots coin-sized hole in ceiling where central pillar hits; trap still active with pillars slamming.
Mist room resets behind them after moving on; current room is rotating crushing-plate chamber; party now opposite side while trap still running.
Vex attempts Robin Hood–level shot at the ceiling hole; Bardic Inspiration d10; attack hits with 35 as pillars slam; Tiberius readying Telekinesis to assist.
Rotating crushing-plate trap disabled by Vex’s near-impossible shot into ceiling hole; Matt confirms pillars grind to a halt after arrow, aided by arcane force; party crosses.
Short rest taken after disabling trap; Matt calls break and allows spending Hit Dice to heal (Vax and others do).
Charity segment: GameChanger Charity featured; donations from tonight’s Critical Role stream will go to GameChanger instead of 826LA; link via chat command; site briefly crashed from donations.
GameChanger promo: Donate >$1 at gamechangercharity.org to receive a free Deus Ex: Director’s Cut; last day of the promo is tonight.
On-air confirmations: Orion and Laura confirm switching donations to GameChanger; Zac clarifies 826LA link on page will route tonight’s proceeds to GameChanger.
